Name: sy_mokarin Dateable (and marry) Caroline
Author: SYmokarin
Description:
This mod was born when we notice there was only one Caroline mod that let you marry her (and cheat on Pierre).
We tried to keep things pretty vanilla (but not way too much honestly). 

This mod includes:
-A new Story arc and schedule for Caroline!
She will visit the archealogy house, go to jodi's house or go to forage in the forest!
-Caroline present in the Flower Dance!h 
-More than 50 new quotes for our beloved tea-lover! 
-A few dialogues from Pierre and Abigail related to you being married with their wife/mother!
-A special 10 heart event for Caroline in her sunroom.
-Fully functional post marriage features: A new spouseroom, patio, schedule and Dialogue
-6 new sprites for Caroline.



Credits:
@sy_mokarin: original idea, pixel art, dialogues and writing.
@MamaNachona: making the patch.
